rule_pipeline_stages.name: Baseline computation
rule_pipeline_stages.method: Per region: avg tail count over 365d / 100 -> probability p_region

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Rule enumeration
rule_pipeline_stages.method: For each (target_region, target_weekday) in 21 buckets: enumerate (source_region, source_offset, station, prize_key) from region-specific src_cfgs.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Statistical metrics
rule_pipeline_stages.method: For each rule: compute hit_rate_365, hr_4w/8w/12w/16w, lift_365 (= hr/baseline), streak, gap, stability.
rule_pipeline_stages.why: Windows 4/8/12/16W fixed BUT baseline used in lift is per-region.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Scoring + tier classification
rule_pipeline_stages.method: score_rule() applies threshold-based bumps. composite_score = 0.50*hr12w + 0.35*hr16w + 0.10*hr4w + 0.05*confidence. cumulative_rank_score = composite + verdict_bonus + stability_bonus + evidence_bonus + use_bonus + legacy_bonus - living_penalty.
rule_pipeline_stages.why: Coefficients same, but rule input features differ per region.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Top-5 selection per bucket
rule_pipeline_stages.method: For each of 21 buckets: rank by cumulative_rank_score DESC, keep top 5.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: DB persist + version tag
rule_pipeline_stages.method: DELETE FROM mined_rules; INSERT new top-5 per bucket; tag rule_version = v{ISO_YEAR}W{ISO_WEEK}; activation_status = shadow.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Daily MRE evaluation
rule_pipeline_stages.method: For each active rule, look up source date data and check if predicted tails appear in target region results.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Lifecycle (promote/demote)
rule_pipeline_stages.method: Promote shadow -> active if hit_rate>=55% & samples>=8. Demote active -> shadow if recent_hit_rate<25% & samples>=8.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Runtime rule lookup
rule_pipeline_stages.method: get_active_rules(target_region, target_date) filters by region + weekday + tier. Apply BUCKET_QUALITY_TABLE suppression.
rule_pipeline_stages.output: list of rules for current bucket
rule_pipeline_stages.why: BUCKET_QUALITY_TABLE and BUCKET_SUPPRESS_THRESHOLD differ per region.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Boost computation
rule_pipeline_stages.method: For each rule produce 2-digit tails from source date. Apply BOOST_TABLE[(tier, prediction_use)]. Apply DH_MULTIPLIER. Apply livingness-weighted boost (84d). Apply convergence cap.
rule_pipeline_stages.why: Same BOOST_TABLE for all regions, but list of rules going in differs.

rule_pipeline_stages.name: Display in UI
rule_pipeline_stages.method: GET /api/prediction-quality computes recommendation per region. Live SQL for WR 14-day. Live lookup for predicted_tails.
rule_pipeline_stages.why: Per-region MB CALIBRATION ceiling (55 vs 70) applied at prompt level.

api_prediction_quality.wr_14d_source: live SQL on predictions table at every request
api_prediction_quality.predicted_tails_source: live SQL on lottery_results at every request
api_prediction_quality.effectiveness_source: daily MRE evaluation, updates lifecycle gates

rules.output: Source -> target mapping with hit_rate, tier
